text:
Carla: Heads-up — customer reported ingest failures after yesterday's prod rollout. Their downstream JSON parser is throwing an 'Extra data' error. They pasted the raw body and it looks like multiple JSON objects concatenated.
Samir: Can you paste the exact raw response and the request id? Any headers?
Carla: Pasting what they sent (redacted ids):

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 1024

{"order":{"id":12345,"items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}]}}{"meta":{"ingest_ts":"2026-03-15T18:23:07Z","model":"redwood-rlhf-v2.1"}}
```

Customer's python error: `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column 62 (char 61)`

Oliver: Do we know which model variant rolled out and whether streaming was involved? That response looks like two top-level objects emitted with no array wrapper or comma — either a framing bug in streaming path or our postprocessing joined two messages.
Katie: Was the customer using streaming? Sometimes streaming-to-regular responses can accidentally concatenate fragments if the finalization path flushes twice.
Carla: They said streaming=false and Content-Type set to application/json. Model rollout coincided with 2026-03-15 18:10 UTC canary -> prod. Their failing request time 18:23 UTC. Request id they gave: r-0ac4b9e2 (redacted).
eng-runtime-bot: Observed anomaly: several requests around 18:20-18:30 show two completion flush events in the runtime logs for same request id range. Flagging for eng-runtime and eng-infra.
Samir: Quick triage checklist: 1) capture full raw TCP body (not parsed by proxies); 2) check for connection reuse/retry at LB level; 3) verify we didn't change streaming framing or prefix-caching behavior in the rollout. Ask CS to ask customer for raw tcp dump if possible.
Carla: Customer provided headers and says no retries on their side. They run python requests with keep-alive. Header snippet they sent: `Connection: keep-alive`, `Content-Type: application/json`, `Content-Length: 1024`.
Oliver: Possible root causes: a) proxy or gateway concatenated two chunked bodies when reusing connection after an upstream reconnect, b) runtime emitted two JSON objects because prefix cache replayed a cached completion followed by live completion, c) our finalizer double-wrote the metadata envelope in a rare race.
Katie: Can someone repro locally by calling the same model/version with same prompt and forcing a mid-request reconnect or simulated cache hit? Carla can you run `curl --raw -v` against the customer's request payload to capture exact body we return?
Carla: Ran the curl with the customer's prompt using redwood-rlhf-v2.1 (non-streaming). Command and snippet:

```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rlhf-v2.1","prompt":"<redacted>","stream":false}' --raw

# raw body returned:
{"order":{"id":12345,"items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}]}}{"meta":{"ingest_ts":"2026-03-15T18:23:07Z","model":"redwood-rlhf-v2.1"}}
```
Samir: That's reproducible — thanks. Escalating now: eng-runtime please investigate flush/retry semantics and eng-infra check LB connection reuse logic around the rollout window. Short-term mitigation: recommend rolling back the tenant to the previous model variant or enabling a compatibility wrapper on the customer's side (split on `}{` and rejoin with comma inside an array) while we patch.
Carla: Customer prefers rollback, they asked for ETA.
eng-runtime-bot: Canary paused and tenant-specific rollback to redwood-rlhf-v2.0 initiated at 18:50 UTC. We logged the run ids and captured runtime traces for r-0ac4b9e2 family.
Katie: Follow-up action items: 1) add an E2E test to ensure single JSON object contract when `stream=false`; 2) audit prefix-cache replay and finalizer race conditions; 3) add an integration test simulating mid-request reconnects at LB/proxy layer; 4) notify partners/docs about contract guarantees.
Carla: Noted. I'll update the customer and keep this thread open for any new traces they send. For CS record: tenant id T-9981, contact is eng-integration@acme-corp, rollback accepted.
Samir: Nice work catching this quickly. Please attach the raw curl output and runtime traces to the incident ticket.
Carla: Attaching traces now to INC-2026-721 in Jira. Will follow up once eng-runtime confirms root cause and patch plan. :white_check_mark:
